Title: Normal interior quantity
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup in qa/README.md. 2. Add one tote. 3. Open Bag and set quantity 5. 4. Reload.
Expected Result: One line persists at quantity 5; subtotal $140.00 and header count 5.

Title: Reject quantity 11 on a new line
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup with empty bag and tote stock 30. 2. PUT /api/cart with productId canvas-tote and quantity 11. 3. GET /api/cart.
Expected Result: HTTP 400 integer-range error; bag remains empty with subtotal 0.

Title: Twenty-nine distinct products
Steps: 1. Use capacity setup. 2. PUT quantity 1 for each of 29 distinct products. 3. GET /api/cart.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 for every update; 29 distinct lines and subtotal $29.00.

Title: Free a slot at capacity
Steps: 1. Establish TC-086. 2. PUT quantity 0 for the first ID. 3. Add unused thirty-first ID at quantity 1.
Expected Result: Both updates return HTTP 200; 30 lines remain, removed ID is absent and new ID is present.

Title: Quantity type errors
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup with tote quantity 2. 2. Separately PUT quantity as string 2, null, true and omitted. 3. GET bag after each request.
Expected Result: Each request returns HTTP 400 integer-range error; bag remains at quantity 2 and subtotal $56.00.

Title: Combined code normalization
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup with one tote. 2. Apply two spaces + wElCoMe10 + two spaces in Bag. 3. Continue to checkout.
Expected Result: Canonical code WELCOME10; subtotal $28.00, discount $2.80, shipping $5.00 and total $30.20 on both pages.

Title: Thirty-character unsupported code
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup with one tote. 2. POST quote with 30 ASCII A characters.
Expected Result: HTTP 400 That discount code is not valid, not a length error; bag unchanged.

Title: Normalized code length boundary
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup with one tote. 2. POST quote with 11 spaces + WELCOME10 + 11 spaces (31 raw characters).
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with canonical WELCOME10 and discount 280 cents because the normalized code has 9 characters. Implementation-derived trimming interpretation.

Title: Discount rounding below and above half-cent
Steps: 1. Use price setup for one item. 2. Quote WELCOME10 at price 1004 cents. 3. Change price to 1006 cents and quote again.
Expected Result: Discounts are 100 and 101 cents respectively; totals are 1404 and 1405 cents including 500-cent shipping.

Title: Reject invalid code on order submission
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Submit baseline delivery with discountCode SAVE20. 3. Compare bag, stock and QA order count.
Expected Result: HTTP 400 That discount code is not valid. No order, stock deduction or bag clearing occurs.

Title: Full name maximum
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Set only name to 100 ASCII N characters and submit.

Title: Address maximum
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Set only address to 200 ASCII A characters and submit.

Title: City lower boundary pair
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Submit baseline delivery with city C. 3. Verify unchanged snapshots. 4. Submit with city LA and a fresh checkout key.
Expected Result: First request: HTTP 400 City must be 2–80 characters and unchanged bag/stock/order count. Second: HTTP 201 with city LA.

Title: Postal code lower and upper boundaries
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Submit postalCode P and verify snapshots unchanged. 3. Submit postalCode equal to 20 ASCII P characters with a new key.
Expected Result: First request: HTTP 400 Postal code must be 2–20 characters, no state changes. Second: HTTP 201 preserving all 20 characters.

Title: Every delivery field required on server
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. For each of name, email, address, city and postalCode, separately submit baseline with that field omitted, then empty, then three spaces. 3. Use a fresh checkout key for every attempt.
Expected Result: All 15 attempts return HTTP 400 identifying the invalid field. Bag, stock and order count equal their pre-request snapshots.

Title: Trim before delivery length checks
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Submit name as space + A + space and verify unchanged snapshots. 3. With a new key submit each baseline field padded by two spaces, replacing name with 100 N characters, address with 200 A characters, city with 80 C characters and postalCode with 20 P characters.
Expected Result: First request: HTTP 400 Full name must be 2–100 characters despite raw length 3. Second: HTTP 201 with all fields trimmed to their inclusive maxima.

Title: Delivery email maximum and above
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Build email as 64 a characters + @ + 63 b characters + dot + 63 c characters + dot + 61 d characters (254 total). 3. Submit. 4. Prepare a new bag, append one d (255 total) and submit with a new key.
Expected Result: 254-character format-valid email accepted with HTTP 201. 255-character email rejected with HTTP 400 Email must be 3–254 characters; second bag, stock and order count unchanged.

Title: Delivery email format and short lengths
Steps: 1. Use order API setup. 2. Separately submit email values a, ab, a@b, a b@example.com, a@@b.com and a@b.c, using a new key each time and baseline other fields. 3. Place valid value last.
Expected Result: First two return HTTP 400 length error; next three return HTTP 400 Enter a valid email. All rejected attempts preserve snapshots. a@b.c returns HTTP 201. No valid email format can satisfy the nominal 3-character minimum.

Title: Invalid delivery corrected through checkout
Steps: 1. Use fresh shopper setup and open checkout with one tote. 2. Fill baseline delivery except Full name is three spaces. 3. Place demo order. 4. Verify server rejection and bag retained. 5. Correct Full name to Alex Shopper and submit.
Expected Result: First submission returns HTTP 400 Full name must be 2–100 characters, displays an alert and remains in checkout. Second returns HTTP 201, shows confirmation and empties the bag.
